steps.key: {d} major has two sharps, {fSharp} and {cSharp}. Rather than next to every note, the music writes them once, at the start of each line: the key signature. Every {f} and every {c} is then played sharp, in every octave. The scale has the same fingering as {c} major: 1 2 3, the thumb under, 1 2 3 4 5.
steps.scaleRight: The scale with the right hand, up and back down: the key signature reminds you of the two sharps.
steps.scaleLeft: The left hand: 5 4 3 2 1, then finger 3 crosses over the thumb: 3 2 1.
steps.odeInD: A tune you know, in a new key: “Ode to Joy” in {d} major starts on {fSharp}. No sharp is written next to the notes: the key signature says it.
